item.title: Man admits to holding drugs for a third party
item.description: By Ronan Judge A 28-year-old Galway man who was ‘holding’ drugs for a third party when he was intercepted by Gardaí, will be sentenced later this year. At Galway Circuit Court, Cian Burke confirmed guilty pleas to eight offences contrary to the Misuse of Drugs Act.
